title: Venezuela's Nicolas Maduro and wife Cilia Flores deny US torture charges as 'false accusations'
summary: Ousted Venezuelan president Nicolas Maduro and his wife Cilia Flores pleaded not guilty on Thursday to new torture charges brought against them by US authorities, calling them “false allegations".
